why: The best line is constant and must be improved directly.
stop: Close after 3 experiments without a real gain over 0.666667.
purpose: What step-height profile maximizes R when starting from the constant best line, and can local height optimization find a peaked bump?
plan: Run a stochastic hill-climb/memetic search on 50-200 heights initialized from p0001's constant array; if it gains, refine the best profile with more mutations and smoothing; if not, test a direct [1,2,1]-style bump.

why: Shape discovery off the best line may reveal a better construction class.
stop: Close after 3 experiments without a real gain over the best known R.
purpose: Which parametric or discovered shape family gives the largest R, and what qualitative shape does it have?
plan: Explore a smooth power-exponential bump family and an evolutionary search over small-support heights; if either beats 0.68, branch to refine its best shape and scale it to larger N.

why: p0003 is the best line and higher resolution is the untested lever.
plan: Refine p0003 multiscale: polish at N=50, then linearly upsample to N=100 and N=200 and re-optimize each with local search, keeping the global best. If it gains, push resolution further and make it the new base; if not, resolution is saturated at N=50.

why: Tests whether the dense-bump local optimum is global or whether gaps/multi-hump structure helps.
stop: 3 experiments without a real gain over 0.8404.
purpose: What structural features (asymmetry, zero gaps, number of humps) characterize the best shape, and is p0003 a strong local optimum?
plan: Run basin-hopping/annealing from p0003 with large structural moves (zero blocks, split/merge humps) plus local refinement; if a structurally different shape beats 0.8404, adopt its features; if not, conclude 0.8404 is a robust local optimum.

why: p0005 is the best of a separate line; let it mature at higher N.
plan: Branch from p0005: refine its construction at higher resolution with a population/genetic search (crossover + multiplicative mutation + local polish), compare its basin to p0003's. If it gains, keep the line alive; if not, deprioritize it.

why: p0013 is the best and random mutation is exhausted; gradient/coordinate methods are untried mechanisms.
plan: From p0013, apply numerical-gradient projected ascent at N=200 (then 400) with backtracking line search, and separately exact block-coordinate golden-section line search, keeping the global best. If either beats 0.841166, push resolution and adopt as base; if not, local polish is saturated and effort shifts to structural/parametric changes.

why: p0005 basin refined only to 0.8278 (p0012 loss); the sparse line is clearly inferior to the dense bump at 0.8412.
p0013's f*f peak at 0.500 hints the optimum may be symmetric, which would change the search space.
plan: Test the symmetry hypothesis: symmetrize p0013, re-optimize at N=200; if a symmetric-constrained shape matches the best, adopt a symmetric parametrization. Also, if slots allow later, test a principled two-hump/comb against the dense bump. If neither beats, the dense bump is confirmed.

why: p0019's only gain came from this stage; exploit it directly.
plan: From p0019, run many annealed perturb-restart cycles (multiplicative noise 1-10%, short PGD after each) at N=100 and N=200, keeping the global best; if it beats 0.842478 by >=1e-4, adopt and push N; if not, the restart mechanism is also saturated at this basin.

why: Tests the mechanism behind the ascent stall.
stop: 3 experiments without a real gain over 0.842478.
purpose: Does smoothing the max in ||f*f||_inf (soft-max, annealed temperature) unlock dense gradients and faster ascent than the hard-max numerical gradient?
plan: From p0019, run gradient ascent on num/(s^2 * softmax(L)) at N=200 with temperature annealed 1e-2 -> 1e-5, plus perturb restarts. If it beats 0.8425, adopt; if not, the hard max is not the bottleneck.

why: Symmetry question answered (neutral); structural moves (gaps/multi-hump) found nothing over 2 experiments.
p0015 is the strongest off-line (0.841394) and its gain came from exactly this mechanism.
purpose: Does p0015's high-resolution basin (N=3200, coordinate refine + perturb restarts) reach or beat the p0019 line when pushed further?
plan: From p0015, mass-preserving resample to N=800 and 3200, coordinate-ascent refine at each level, then many annealed perturb-restart cycles; if it beats 0.842478 adopt as new best line, else deprioritize.
